import: Add JPG, PNG or WebP images
drop: Drop images here or choose files
limits: Static images only. Up to 30 files / 100 MiB total; 16,384 px per side and 40 megapixels per image. All processing stays on this device.
cropNote: Drag the selection to crop. Apply the crop to save it before processing. Reopen an image to start again from its original. Cropping runs before resizing and compression.
target: Target size per file (KiB; 0 = quality only)
allowReduce: Allow lower resolution to reach target size
jpegNotice: JPEG fills transparent pixels with white. EXIF metadata is removed; native image decoding applies phone orientation. PNG ignores quality during initial encoding; target compression may reduce colors and still miss the requested size.
targetMiss: Target size could not be reached with these settings.
unsupported: Use valid static JPG, PNG or WebP files.
animated: Animated PNG and WebP files are unsupported.
dimensions: Image dimensions must be 1–16,384 px per side and at most 40 megapixels; scale must be 1–400%.
limit: Limit exceeded: 30 images, 100 MiB total input/output, 50 MiB per input.
failed: Image processing failed. Check the input or use a smaller image.
formatError: This browser cannot encode the chosen output format.
invalidSettings: Quality must be 1–100, target size 0–102,400 KiB, and dimensions / scale must be valid numbers.
name: Compress and edit images
description: Make an image smaller for uploading, crop unwanted areas, change its dimensions, or convert PNG, JPG and WebP. Add images, process, then download.
